$comment: Shared behavioural contract for the text structure pass.
Sibling to dictionary-test-vectors.json and read the same way: this file is the
specification, not a record of what the code happens to do. The macOS app runs it in
Swift; the Windows app is expected to run the identical file in C# once its platform
layer exists. Change behaviour here first, watch the implementations go red, then make
The pass runs in two halves, because they need the text at different moments:
preClean  - retraction and spoken commands, on the raw transcript, before any
cleanup. These rules must see the words exactly as they were said.
structure - lists, email shape, terminal punctuation and the join onto text already
in the field, on the cleaned transcript, immediately before injection.
Each case names the phase it exercises. `options` overrides the defaults below; any
key left out takes the default.
field: unknown, listStyle: numbered, retractionScope: sentence, commandsEnabled: true,
listsEnabled: true, retractionEnabled: true, signOffEnabled: true, autoSignOff: true,
polishGuardCases are separate: they check the guard around the optional grammar-repair
model pass, which is allowed to change words and therefore cannot use the cleanup
guard. `accepted` is what the guard must return for that pair.

cases.name: retraction takes back the sentence it followed
cases.input: I'll send the report next week. Actually no, scratch that. I'll send it today.
cases.expected: I'll send it today.

cases.name: a retraction in its own sentence reaches back past itself
cases.input: Let's go with the blue one. Scratch that. Let's go with the green one.
cases.expected: Let's go with the green one.

cases.name: a wide retraction discards everything before it
cases.input: Tell them we can do it on Monday, scratch all that, tell them we need another week.
cases.expected: tell them we need another week.

cases.name: a retraction with nothing after it is content, not a command
cases.input: I checked the numbers again and that's wrong.
cases.expected: I checked the numbers again and that's wrong.

cases.name: a repeated word says where the repair starts
cases.input: I want to meet you at 4, no wait at 3.
cases.expected: I want to meet you at 3.

cases.name: alignment keeps the rest of the sentence
cases.input: Let's meet at three, no wait, at four.
cases.expected: Let's meet at four.

cases.name: a bare number swaps the number it replaces
cases.input: I need 3 things, no wait 4.
cases.expected: I need 4 things.

cases.name: a weekday swaps a weekday
cases.input: Send it Tuesday, no wait Wednesday.
cases.expected: Send it Wednesday.

cases.name: alignment survives a repeated verb
cases.input: I'll call the client, then I'll email the team, no wait, I'll email them first.
cases.expected: I'll call the client, then I'll email them first.

cases.name: a whole clause is a restatement, not a repair
cases.input: We should ship the beta, no wait, the beta is not ready yet.
cases.expected: the beta is not ready yet.

cases.name: clause scope stops at the previous clause when nothing aligns
cases.input: I'll call the client, then I'll email the team, no wait, let's just cancel it.
cases.expected: I'll call the client, let's just cancel it.

cases.name: retraction can be switched off
cases.input: Let's go with the blue one. Scratch that. Let's go with the green one.
cases.expected: Let's go with the blue one. Scratch that. Let's go with the green one.

cases.name: an ordinary apology is not a retraction
cases.input: Sorry for the delay, I was travelling all week.
cases.expected: Sorry for the delay, I was travelling all week.

cases.name: new paragraph and new line are structure, not words
cases.input: the draft is ready new paragraph let me know what you think
cases.expected:
the draft is ready

let me know what you think

cases.name: bullet point starts an item
cases.input: here is the plan bullet point ship the beta bullet point collect feedback
cases.expected:
here is the plan
• ship the beta
• collect feedback

cases.name: spoken numbers number themselves
cases.input: number one buy milk number two call the bank
cases.expected:
1. buy milk
2. call the bank

cases.name: next item follows the destination's list style
cases.input: the agenda next item budget next item hiring
cases.expected:
the agenda
• budget
• hiring

cases.name: a continued list keeps counting from the caret
cases.input: next item book the flight
cases.expected: 3. book the flight

cases.name: all caps and cap that
cases.input: this is all caps urgent and murmur cap that ships today
cases.expected: this is URGENT and Murmur ships today

cases.name: line breaks collapse in a single-line field
cases.input: swift concurrency new line docs
cases.expected: swift concurrency docs

cases.name: commands can be switched off
cases.input: the draft is ready new paragraph let me know
cases.expected: the draft is ready new paragraph let me know

cases.name: spoken ordinals become a numbered list
cases.input: I need three things. First, buy milk. Second, call the bank. Third, book the flight.
cases.expected:
I need three things:
1. Buy milk
2. Call the bank
3. Book the flight

cases.name: list style follows the destination
cases.input: I need three things. First, buy milk. Second, call the bank. Third, book the flight.
cases.expected:
I need three things:
• Buy milk
• Call the bank
• Book the flight

cases.name: an ordinal doing ordinary work is not a list
cases.input: The first thing I noticed was the colour.
cases.expected: The first thing I noticed was the colour.

cases.name: one item is not a list
cases.input: First I need coffee.
cases.expected: First I need coffee.

cases.name: a list out of order is not a list
cases.input: Second guessing this whole thing. Third parties are involved.
cases.expected: Second guessing this whole thing. Third parties are involved.

cases.name: no lists in a code editor
cases.input: First, buy milk. Second, call the bank
cases.expected: First, buy milk. Second, call the bank

cases.name: nothing is joined onto the caret in a terminal
cases.input: Fix the leak
cases.expected: Fix the leak

cases.name: no full stop appended in a code editor
cases.input: let total = items.count.
cases.expected: let total = items.count

cases.name: lists can be switched off
cases.input: First, buy milk. Second, call the bank.
cases.expected: First, buy milk. Second, call the bank.

cases.name: a list continues the numbering above the caret
cases.input: First, book the flight. Second, pack.
cases.expected:
3. Book the flight
4. Pack

cases.name: closing and name become a signature block
cases.input: I'll have it over by Friday. Thanks Rohit
cases.expected:
I'll have it over by Friday.

Thanks,
Rohit

cases.name: the configured spelling of the name wins
cases.input: Let me know if that works. Best regards rohit shidid
cases.expected:
Let me know if that works.

Best regards,
Rohit Shidid

cases.name: a bare closing signs itself when auto sign-off is on
cases.input: Let me know. Thanks.
cases.expected:
Let me know.

Thanks,
Rohit

cases.name: auto sign-off off leaves a bare closing alone
cases.input: Let me know. Thanks.
cases.expected: Let me know. Thanks.

cases.name: no configured name means no signature
cases.input: Let me know. Thanks.
cases.expected: Let me know. Thanks.

cases.name: a greeting becomes its own line
cases.input: Hi Sarah I wanted to check on the invoice.
cases.expected:
Hi Sarah,

I wanted to check on the invoice.

cases.name: a greeting with no name does not invent one
cases.input: Hi I wanted to check on the invoice.
cases.expected:
Hi,

I wanted to check on the invoice.

cases.name: a greeting halfway down an email is a word
cases.input: Hi Sarah mentioned the invoice.
cases.expected: Hi Sarah mentioned the invoice.

cases.name: email shape does not apply outside an email body
cases.input: I'll have it over by Friday. Thanks Rohit
cases.expected: I'll have it over by Friday. Thanks Rohit

cases.name: a continued sentence is not capitalised
cases.input: And bought milk.
cases.expected: and bought milk.

cases.name: a finished sentence keeps its capital
cases.input: And bought milk.
cases.expected: And bought milk.

cases.name: a name after a continuation is not lowercased
cases.input: Sarah about it.
cases.expected: Sarah about it.

cases.name: an acronym after a continuation is left alone
cases.input: AWS every night.
cases.expected: AWS every night.

cases.name: no full stop in a search field
cases.input: Swift concurrency.
cases.expected: Swift concurrency

cases.name: no full stop on a subject line
cases.input: Invoice for August.
cases.expected: Invoice for August

cases.name: a question mark survives a field that wants no full stop
cases.input: Are we still on for Friday?
cases.expected: Are we still on for Friday?

polishGuardCases.name: ordinary grammar repair is allowed
polishGuardCases.original: me and him goes to the store yesterday and we buys milk
polishGuardCases.polished: He and I went to the store yesterday and we bought milk.

polishGuardCases.name: a changed number is rejected
polishGuardCases.original: let's ship it at 3 pm and send 250 invites
polishGuardCases.polished: Let's ship it at 3 pm and send 350 invites.

polishGuardCases.name: an invented name is rejected
polishGuardCases.original: can you review the doc before the standup
polishGuardCases.polished: Can you review the doc before the standup, Sarah?

polishGuardCases.name: a changed URL is rejected
polishGuardCases.original: the docs are at example.com/guide and I linked them
polishGuardCases.polished: The docs are at example.com/guides, and I linked them.

polishGuardCases.name: a changed identifier is rejected
polishGuardCases.original: the bug is in HUDPanel and it only happens on launch
polishGuardCases.polished: The bug is in HUDPanels, and it only happens on launch.

polishGuardCases.name: a summary is rejected
polishGuardCases.original: so the thing I wanted to say is that the deploy went out this morning and everything looks fine on the dashboards and nobody has reported anything

polishGuardCases.name: the model explaining itself is rejected
polishGuardCases.original: me and him goes to the store
polishGuardCases.polished: Here's the corrected sentence: He and I went to the store.
